text: At that moment. <break time="0.8s" /> Someone knocked at the door. <break time="0.8s" /> And an old man named Geppetto. <break time="0.8s" /> Came in. <break time="0.8s" /> He was a poor man. <break time="0.8s" /> Who lived alone in a tiny room. <break time="0.8s" /> The boys of the neighborhood. <break time="0.8s" /> Called him Polendina. <break time="0.8s" /> Because his yellow wig. <break time="0.8s" /> Looked like corn pudding. <break time="0.8s" /> Geppetto hated this name. <break time="0.8s" /> And he became very angry. <break time="0.8s" /> Whenever he heard it. <break time="0.8s" /> I want to make. <break time="0.8s" /> A wonderful wooden puppet. <break time="0.8s" /> That can dance and jump. <break time="0.8s" /> He said. <break time="0.8s" /> With this puppet. <break time="0.8s" /> I will travel around the world. <break time="0.8s" /> And earn my bread. <break time="0.8s" /> Just then. <break time="0.8s" /> The tiny voice in the log shouted. <break time="0.8s" /> Good idea, Polendina. <break time="0.8s" /> Geppetto thought. <break time="0.8s" /> That Master Cherry had said it. <break time="0.8s" /> So the two old men. <break time="0.8s" /> Started to fight. <break time="0.8s" /> After the fight. <break time="0.8s" /> They shook hands. <break time="0.8s" /> And promised. <break time="0.8s" /> To be good friends again. <break time="0.8s" /> But when Master Cherry. <break time="0.8s" /> Handed him the log. <break time="0.8s" /> It jumped. <break time="0.8s" /> And hit Geppetto hard on the leg. <break time="0.8s" /> They argued again. <break time="0.8s" /> But at last. <break time="0.8s" /> Geppetto took the log under his arm. <break time="0.8s" /> And limped home.
